hook: HC seeks police reply on Task Force searches *without FIRs*
hook_b: HC seeks police reply on Task Force searches *without FIRs*
tldr: Justice T. Madhavi Devi issued notices to the Home Department, DGP, Hyderabad CP and DCP (Task Force) on a Borabanda resident's writ petition.

beats.what: The High Court on Tuesday sought explanations from the Home Department, DGP, Hyderabad Police Commissioner and DCP (Task Force) on the allegations.
beats.why: The petitioner alleges Task Force personnel search and seize in civilian clothes, without registering an FIR or following a transparent procedure, contrary to the BNSS 2023.
beats.care: The respondents must file explanations; the court has not ruled on the allegations yet.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 18): The matter was adjourned to December 12. Police responses are not public yet.

cards.q: Police searches in plain clothes: where do you stand?

qs: What does the BNSS say about searches before an FIR is filed?
Who can issue a search warrant under the law?

facts.t: The plea says pre-FIR searches break the *2023* Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita.

viz.verdict: Court has sought replies; no ruling yet

steps.e: Notices to Home Dept, DGP, CP, DCP

viz.verdict: Home Dept, DGP, Hyderabad CP and DCP (Task Force)

learn.t: BNSS = Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, India's new criminal procedure code

watch: What the police tell the court at the Dec 12 hearing.

fact: High Court seeks Hyderabad police reply on plea alleging Task Force searches *without FIRs*
twist: The plea also questions whether ACPs can issue search warrants at all, saying only judicial magistrates can.
